name: KETOROLAC / TRAMADOL 10/25MG 10 CAPSULES ORDEGAN
description: They are used as a short-term treatment to relieve severe pain (pain that starts suddenly, has a specific cause, and is expected to disappear when the cause of the pain is treated) in people who are expected to need an opioid painkiller and whose pain cannot be controlled with alternative painkillers. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
